taraweeh.note: The four students are confirmed about a month before Ramadan, and this list updates in the app when they are.

bayaan.note: Changes are announced in the app. Turn on Announcements to hear about them.

itikaf.lead: Staying in the masjid for the last ten nights. Places are limited, so the committee asks that you book.
itikaf.asks: You will be asked for a name, a phone number and which nights.

fitrana.per: Per person in the household, including children.
fitrana.note: The amount is set by the committee each year and announced in the masjid.

eid.note: Eid times are announced once the moon has been sighted.

lastTen.lead: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months. The masjid stays open through each of these nights.
lastTen.kicker: Seek it in the odd nights

parking.lead: The masjid car park is on Draycott Street. Please use it first.
parking.note: When it is full, park with consideration for our neighbours and the wider community — never across a driveway. The masjid sits on a main road, so take care pulling out, and keep hold of children.
